subject: Next steps: security evidence & vuln-scan cadence (post-demo)
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@heartlandhealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com, monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Fri, 07 May 2026 16:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps: security evidence & vuln-scan cadence (post-demo)

Hi Alex — thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re aligned on security due diligence items you flagged:

1) SOC 2 / Compliance
- Current state: we can share a SOC 2 summary and Type II timeline.
- Ask from your side: confirm what specific artifacts you need (summary, controls matrix, auditor contact).

2) Data protection (GDPR / HIPAA)
- Riska scope: Redwood supports both GDPR and HIPAA deployments; we can provide our data flow diagram and HIPAA BA terms.

3) Vendor security questionnaire / Evidence collection
- Please send your questionnaire (thank you for the copy you attached to the demo notes — I’ve CC’d procurement).

4) Pen test & vulnerability management
- You asked for a recent penetration test report and our vulnerability management SLAs (cadence, severity SLAs, disclosure policy).
- Proposed immediate action: if you can share the specific fields you need from the pen report we’ll return a redacted copy. For operational items, below is our suggested cadence: quarterly scans + annual third-party pentest; critical fixes targeted within 48 hours, high within 7 days.

Next steps (proposed):
- Alex / procurement: confirm which artifacts you want first (SOC2 summary vs full report vs questionnaire answers) and whether you need an NDA before we share redacted penetration test evidence.
- Rishi: I’ve looped you in to provide the technical pen-test redactions and the vuln-mgmt brief.
- Monica: please prepare a one-pager on HIPAA controls and data residency options we can hand to their security team.

I’ll hold a short follow-up call next week if that helps (15–20 minutes). What works for you?

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
neha@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0186

Attachment stubs: redwood-soc2-summary-2025.pdf (summary), vendor-security-questionnaire-heartland.xlsx (their questionnaire copy)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@heartlandhealth.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@heartlandhealth.com
Date: Fri, 07 May 2026 17:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: security evidence & vuln-scan cadence (post-demo)

Neha — appreciate the recap. Quick answers from our side: 

- SOC 2: we need a SOC 2 Type II report if available; if not yet complete then a Type I + auditor contact and timeline to Type II is acceptable.
- HIPAA: Heartland will require a signed BA (we can start a template NDA/BA exchange).
- Questionnaire: attaching our vendor security questionnaire (procurement copied). We typically ask for completed questionnaires within 7 business days.

Regarding the pen test report: we can accept a redacted version that removes sensitive internal IP and customer-identifiable info. We do require the scope and date of the test, severity breakdown, and remediation status per finding. NDAs are preferable before exchanging full reports but our procurement team can handle that.

About cadence / SLAs: your proposed cadence sounds reasonable. Two clarifying asks: 1) do you have a defined disclosure policy (e.g., coordinated disclosure window with vendors)? 2) what is your typical remediation SLAs in practice for critical vs high?

I can get procurement to issue an NDA link. We’re targeting decision on vendor selection by the end of June.

Thanks,
Alex Turner
Security Program Manager
Heartland Health
alex.turner@heartlandhealth.com
Phone: +1 (212) 555-0192

Attachment: vendor-security-questionnaire-heartland.xlsx

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwoodinference.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@heartlandhealth.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: monica_patel@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sat, 08 May 2026 07:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps: security evidence & vuln-scan cadence (post-demo)

On Fri, May 7, 2026 at 4:12 PM Neha Kapoor <neha@redwoodinference.com> wrote:
> (see above)

Hi Alex — thanks for the detailed list. A few concrete items from the infra/security side so you have what you asked for: 

1) SOC 2 / Auditor
- We have a SOC 2 Type I from 2024 and Type II audit is expected Q3 2026. I’m attaching a short SOC2 summary doc with control status.

2) Pen test report / redaction approach
- We can provide a redacted PDF of our most recent third-party penetration test (Nov 2025). Redaction will remove internal hostnames, customer data, and exploit PoCs; we will preserve the scope (IP ranges/services), finding severity, CVE references, and remediation status.
- Attachment: redwood-pen-report-redacted-2025.pdf (stub)

3) Vulnerability management & SLAs (summary)
- Scanning cadence: weekly authenticated scanning for prod services, quarterly external scans, annual 3rd-party pentest.
- Remediation SLA (target): Critical = 48 hours (mitigation plan within 24 hours), High = 7 days, Medium = 30 days, Low = next minor release.
- Disclosure policy: coordinated disclosure with 90-day public disclosure target for third-party findings; expedited timelines for critical findings.
- Attachment: vuln-management-process-brief.md (stub)

4) Evidence exchange process
- We prefer to share redacted pen reports under a mutual NDA. If procurement can send the NDA link (DocuSign), we’ll sign and share the full redacted report.

5) Additional artifacts we can supply on request: controls matrix (mapping to SOC 2), HIPAA BA template, data flow diagram.

If that aligns, Neha / Monica — can you coordinate getting the NDA executed and then I’ll upload the redacted report and vuln brief to a secure link?

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Solutions Architect, Security
Redwood Inference
rishi@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: redwood-pen-report-redacted-2025.pdf, vuln-management-process-brief.md
